title: DoSync CapabilityManifest
description: Self-declaration of a physical device's capabilities. Sent to POST /v1/devices/register when the device joins the network. The hub uses it to determine device participation in intent resolution.

device_id.description: Globally unique device identifier within a hub. Stable across restarts and firmware updates.

firmware.description: Firmware version string. Used to detect firmware updates on re-registration.

category.description: Primary device category. 'hybrid' devices both sense and actuate.

tags.description: Semantic tags used by the resolver to match intents. Tags declare what the device is and where it is. See DEPLOYMENT-TAGS-GUIDE.md for the full tag vocabulary.

sensors.description: Sensors this device can report. Each sensor is a named capability.

actuators.description: Actions this device can execute. Each actuator is a named, typed capability.

events.description: Events this device can emit spontaneously (e.g. motion_detected, malfunction).

emergency_capable.description: Whether this device participates in emergency intents with urgency='emergency'. Emergency-capable devices receive a scoring bonus and MUST execute immediately when an emergency intent is resolved.

cert_tier.description: Highest certification tier this device has passed. Null means not yet certified.

dosync_version.description: Protocol version this manifest was built against.

adapter.description: Adapter type used to communicate with this device. Matches the adapter_name field of the DoSyncAdapter implementation.

adapter_config.description: Adapter-specific connection parameters. Redacted from public API responses (GET /v1/devices). Not part of the protocol wire format — for hub-internal use only.

id.description: Unique sensor identifier within this device.

type.description: Sensor type. Examples: temperature, motion, humidity, door_contact, smoke.

poll_interval_ms.description: How often the sensor is polled in milliseconds. 0 means event-driven.

id.description: Unique actuator identifier within this device.

type.description: Actuator type. Examples: turn_on, turn_off, unlock, lock, notify, alarm, set_temperature.

params_schema.description: JSON Schema fragment describing valid params for this actuator.

actuators.description: Turn on at specified brightness and color
